questions.hi: एक संख्या में पहले 20% की वृद्धि और फिर नई संख्या में 20% की कमी की जाती है। कुल परिवर्तन क्या होगा?
questions.en: A number is first increased by 20% and then the new value is decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
questions.whyEn: 1.20×0.80=0.96; the final value is 96% of the original, a 4% decrease.
questions.subject: Numerical and Mathematical Ability

questions.en: One pipe fills a tank in 6 hours and another empties it in 9 hours. How long will the empty tank take to fill if both are open?
questions.whyEn: Net rate=1/6−1/9=1/18 tank per hour; time is 18 hours.

questions.hi: दो संख्याओं का HCF 12 और LCM 420 है। यदि एक संख्या 60 है, तो दूसरी संख्या क्या है?
questions.en: The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their LCM is 420. If one number is 60, find the other.
questions.whyHi: दो संख्याओं का गुणनफल=HCF×LCM=12×420; दूसरी संख्या=5040/60=84।
questions.whyEn: Product of two numbers=HCF×LCM=12×420; other number=5040/60=84.
questions.subject: Numerical and Mathematical Ability

questions.hi: एक व्यक्ति पश्चिम की ओर मुख करके खड़ा है। वह 90° clockwise, फिर 180° anticlockwise घूमता है। अब उसका मुख किस दिशा में है?
questions.en: A person faces west, turns 90° clockwise and then 180° anticlockwise. Which direction is faced now?
questions.whyHi: पश्चिम से 90° clockwise = उत्तर; फिर 180° anticlockwise = दक्षिण।
questions.whyEn: West turned 90° clockwise becomes north; another 180° anticlockwise gives south.

questions.hi: Choose the correct passive voice: 'The clerk prepared the report.'
questions.en: Choose the correct passive voice: 'The clerk prepared the report.'
optionsHi: The report is prepared by the clerk.
The report was prepared by the clerk.
The report has prepared by the clerk.
The report had been prepare by the clerk.
optionsEn: The report is prepared by the clerk.
The report was prepared by the clerk.
The report has prepared by the clerk.
The report had been prepare by the clerk.
questions.whyHi: Simple past active का passive: object + was/were + past participle।
questions.whyEn: The simple past passive is object + was/were + past participle.
